record.title: Approximation of the right-hand side for solutions in the approximation class $A^s$
record.statement: For $s\in(0,\tfrac12]$, conjecture that if the solution $u$ belongs to the approximation class $A^s$, then the corresponding right-hand side $f$ admits, for every $n$, a piecewise-constant approximation on a partition with $n$ elements whose error in the dual norm is of order $n^{-s}$.

record.title: Global convergence of the Yamabe flow on compact three-manifolds
record.statement:
For a compact three-dimensional manifold of positive conformal Yamabe invariant, the Yamabe flow
\[
\frac{\partial}{\partial t}g(t)=(r_{g(t)}-R_{g(t)})g(t),\qquad g(0)=g_0\in[g_{\mathrm{back}}],
\]
started from an arbitrary initial metric converges smoothly to a unique limit metric of constant scalar curvature.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/25](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/830), page 27. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: F-theory interpretation of elliptic partition functions
record.statement: Do the elliptic partition functions coincide with the partition functions of 12-dimensional F-theory compactified on an elliptic curve?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/832), page 11. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Superpolynomial conjecture for Khovanov–Rozansky homology
record.statement:
For every knot $K$, there exists a finite polynomial $C_P(K)\in\mathbb{Z}[a^{\pm1},q^{\pm1},t^{\pm1}]$ such that
\[
\operatorname{KhR}_N(K)(q;t)=\frac{1}{q-q^{-1}}\,C_P(K)(a=q^N,q;t)
\]
for all sufficiently large $N$, where
\[
\operatorname{KhR}_N(K)(q;t):=\sum_{i,j}q^i t^j\dim H\!KR^N_{i,j}(K).
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/832), page 26. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Superpolynomial stabilization for unreduced Khovanov–Rozansky homology
record.statement:
For a knot $K$, there exists a finite polynomial $\overline{\mathcal P}(K)\in\mathbb{Z}[a^{\pm1},q^{\pm1},t^{\pm1}]$ such that
\[
\overline{\mathrm{KhR}}_{N}(q,t)=\frac{1}{q-q^{-1}}\,\overline{\mathcal P}(a=q^{N},q,t)
\]
for all sufficiently large $N$, where
\[
\overline{\mathrm{KhR}}_{N}(q,t):=\sum_{i,j}q^{i}t^{j}\dim \overline{\mathrm{HKR}}^{N}_{i,j}(K).
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/832), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stabilization conjecture for reduced Khovanov–Rozansky homology
record.statement:
For a knot $K$, there exists a finite polynomial $\mathcal{P}(K)\in\mathbb{Z}_{\ge 0}[a^{\pm1},q^{\pm1},t^{\pm1}]$ such that
$$
\operatorname{KhR}_N(K)(q,t)=\mathcal{P}(a=q^N,q,t)
$$
for all sufficiently large $N$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/27](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/832), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Forcing stationary braid classes in uniformly parabolic dynamics
record.statement: Given a braid $v$ fixed by a particular uniformly parabolic PDE, which other classes of braids $u$ are forced to exist as stationary curves?

record.title: Optimal energy gap for sign-changing entire critical solutions
record.statement: What is the optimal value of $\cvarepsilon_0$ in Theorem 1, asserting that $\cPhi(u)\cge 2^{N/2}S^{N/2}+\cvarepsilon_0$ for every sign-changing solution $u\cin D^{1,2}(\cmathbb{R}^N)$ of $-\cDelta u=|u|^{4/(N-2)}u$?

record.title: Bahri’s discrete inequality for arbitrary numbers of points
record.statement:
Establish whether there exists a constant $c(p)>0$ such that, for all $u\in\mathbb{R}^p$ and all $a_1,\ldots,a_p\in\mathbb{R}^3$, with $A=(\alpha_{ij})_{i,j=1}^p$ defined by
\[
\alpha_{ij}=\begin{cases}0,&i=j,\\ |a_i-a_j|^{-1},&i\ne j,\end{cases}
\]
one has
\[
\sup_{1\le i\le p}\left|u^{\mathsf T}\frac{\partial A}{\partial a_i}u\right|+|Au|^2\ge c(p)\sum_{i\ne j}\frac{u_i^2}{|a_i-a_j|^2}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/29](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1050), page 60. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjecture that Theorem 6 holds with $b^*=1$
record.statement: Assume (A) holds and $m(x)$ is non-negative. For every $c\in(c^*,1)$, the conclusion of Theorem 6 should remain valid with $b^*=1$: whenever $b\in(0,1)$ and $(\mu,\nu)\in\Sigma_c$, the semi-trivial steady state $(\theta,0)$ is globally asymptotically stable.

record.title: At least two distinct prime closed geodesics on every Finsler 2-sphere
record.statement: For every Finsler metric $F$ on the $2$-sphere $S^2$, there exist at least two distinct prime closed geodesics.

record.title: Eventually Small Rank Conjecture
record.statement: Let $C$ be a curve of genus at least $2$. Then there is some $n\ge 1$ such that, for all twists $D_j$ of the multiplication-by-$n$ covering of $C$ with $D_j(\mathbb A_k)\ne\varnothing$, the Jacobian of $D_j$ has a factor $A$ such that $\operatorname{rank} A(k)\le \dim A-2$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1053), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Birch–Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture for elliptic curves over \(\mathbb Q\)
record.statement:
For every elliptic curve \(E/\mathbb Q\), if \(r=\operatorname{rank}E(\mathbb Q)\), then \(\operatorname{ord}_{s=1}L(E,s)=r\), the group \(X(E)\) is finite, and
\[
\frac{L^{(r)}(E,1)}{r!}=\Omega_E\cdot\operatorname{Reg}_E\cdot\prod_p c_p\cdot\frac{\#X(E)}{(\#E(\mathbb Q)_{\mathrm{tor}})^2}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1053), page 50. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finiteness of Tate–Shafarevich groups for rank-2 optimal elliptic curves
record.statement: There are 18 optimal elliptic curves of conductor at most $1000$ and rank $2$ (and none of rank greater than $2$). For these curves $E$, the report states that nobody had proved that the Tate–Shafarevich group $X(E)$ is finite in even a single case.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1053), page 52. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: A conformal gap conjecture for Bach-flat four-manifolds
record.statement:
Conjecture: There exists a positive constant $\varepsilon$ such that the only Bach-flat conformal structure in dimension four with positive operators $L$ and $P$ satisfying
\[
16\pi^2-\varepsilon\le \int_M \sigma_2(A)\,dV\le 16\pi^2
\]
is the standard conformal structure on the $4$-sphere.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/33](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1054), page 55. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Integrability of vortex problems on a rotating sphere
record.statement: The 3-vortex problem on the rotating sphere is integrable for all vortex strengths. The 4-vortex problem is integrable if $J=0$, where $J=\sum_{\alpha=1}^{N}\Gamma_{\alpha}x_{\alpha}$ is the center-of-vorticity vector.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1055), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Schaeffer's conjecture on determinant–inverse norm inequalities
record.statement:
For every invertible operator (matrix) $T:X\to X$ on an $N$-dimensional Banach space, Schaeffer proved that
\[
\|T^{-1}\|\,|\det T|\le k_N\|T\|^{N-1},
\qquad k_N\le\sqrt{eN}.
\]
His conjecture that the constants $k_N$ could be bounded independently of $N$ is false: the report records lower bounds showing that $k_N$ is unbounded, including $k_N\ge c_3\sqrt N$ for an absolute constant $c_3>0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/36](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1057), page 14. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Direct sums of frequently hypercyclic operators
record.statement: Let $X$ be a separable $F$-space and let $T:X\to X$ be a continuous linear frequently hypercyclic operator, meaning that there exists $x\in X$ such that, for every nonempty open set $U\subset X$, the set $\{n\in\mathbb N:T^n x\in U\}$ has positive lower density. Is the operator $T\oplus T:X\times X\to X\times X$ hypercyclic?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/36](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1057), page 21. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Brennan’s conjecture for conformal maps
record.statement: For all such conformal maps $\tau$ of the unit disk $D$, $\displaystyle\int_D \left(\frac{1}{|\tau'|}\right)^p dA<\infty$ holds for $-\frac{2}{3}<p<2$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/36](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1057), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Distribution of mass by a Bergman function
record.statement:
Let $L^1_a$ be the Bergman space of functions analytic on the unit disk $\D$ with norm $\\|f\|_1=\int_D |f|\,dA$. For $\varepsilon>0$, let $\Sigma_\varepsilon=\{z:|\arg z|<\varepsilon\}$. Conjecture: For every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a $\delta>0$ such that, if $f\in L^1_a$ and $f(0)=0$, then
\[
\int_{f^{-1}(\Sigma_\varepsilon)} |f|\,dA>\delta\,\|f\|_1.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/36](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1057), page 42. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Garnett–Jones approximation problem for Blaschke products
record.statement: Can every Blaschke product be uniformly approximated by interpolating Blaschke products?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/36](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1057), page 43. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Universal strict inequality for the first positive Dirac eigenvalue
record.statement:
Is it true that
$$
\lambda_{\min}^{+}(M,[g_0])<\lambda_{\min}^{+}(S^n)
$$
holds for all manifolds not conformal to the standard sphere $S^n$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/39](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1060), page 5. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Helgason conjecture for joint eigenfunctions on a symmetric space
record.statement:
Let 
\(\mathcal D(X)\) be the algebra of invariant differential operators on \(X\), and define
\[
\mathcal E_\chi(X)=\{u\in C^\infty(X)\mid Du=\chi(D)u\text{ for every }D\in\mathcal D(X)\}.
\]
The Helgason conjecture says that functions in \(\mathcal E_\chi(X)\) are the Poisson transforms of hyperfunctions on the Poisson boundary of \(X\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/39](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1060), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Selberg eigenvalue conjecture for principal congruence subgroups
record.statement:
Let \(\Gamma(N)\subset SL(2,\mathbb Z)\) be the principal congruence subgroup of level \(N\), and let \(X(N)=\Gamma(N)\backslash\mathbb H\). The Selberg conjecture asks whether the first positive eigenvalue \(\lambda_1(X(N))\) of the Laplacian satisfies

$$\lambda_1(X(N))\ge \frac14$$

for all \(N\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/39](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1060), page 33. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Folklore conjecture for the global Weyl remainder on generic negatively curved surfaces
record.statement: On a generic negatively curved surface, the global remainder in Weyl’s law, defined by $R(\lambda)=\int_X R_x(\lambda)$, satisfies $R(\lambda)=O(\lambda^{\varepsilon})$ for every $\varepsilon>0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/39](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1060), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Non-regenerativity of composition structures from simultaneous-multiple-collision coalescents
record.statement: We conjecture that all the corresponding composition structures are non-regenerative, except for the case when \(\Lambda_j\) is the zero measure for all \(j\ge 2\) and \(\Lambda:=\Lambda_1\) is either concentrated at \(0\) or concentrated at \(1\).
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/40](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1061), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Fibering Theorem for uniform embeddings
record.statement: Let the discrete group $\Gamma$ act on the metric spaces $X$ and $Y$ by isometries, and let $p:X\to Y$ be a Lipschitz, $\Gamma$-equivariant map. Assume that $Y$ is an exact space and that the action of $\Gamma$ on $Y$ is cobounded. If there exists $y_0\in Y$ such that for all $n\in\mathbb{N}$ the set $p^{-1}(B(y_0,n))$ is uniformly embeddable, then $X$ is uniformly embeddable.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/41](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1062), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniform embeddability of relatively hyperbolic groups
record.statement: Let $\Gamma$ be a finitely generated discrete group which is relatively hyperbolic with respect to a subgroup $H$. Then $\Gamma$ is uniformly embeddable if and only if $H$ is uniformly embeddable.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/41](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1062), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Qd(p)-free rank-two finite groups have homotopy rank two
record.statement: Let $G$ be a finite group with $\operatorname{rk}(G)=2$. If, for every odd prime $p$, no subquotient of $G$ is isomorphic to $Qd(p)=(\mathbb Z/p\mathbb Z)^2\rtimes \operatorname{SL}_2(\mathbb F_p)$ with the natural action, then $G$ acts freely on a finite CW-complex $Y\simeq S^{n_1}\times S^{n_2}$; equivalently, $h(G)=2$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2005/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/1063), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Algorithmic problems for finitely presented subgroups of direct products of surface groups
record.statement: The conjugacy problem and the membership problem are solvable for every finitely presented subgroup of a direct product of surface groups.

record.title: Stabilization of a weakly reducible splitting of a twisted torus knot complement
record.statement: For the knots $K_m=T(7,17,10m-4)$, with $m\in\mathbb Z$ and sufficiently large $|m|$, is the weakly reducible genus-three Heegaard splitting of $S^3\setminus N(K_m)$ obtained by $\partial$-stabilization from its unique minimal-genus genus-two Heegaard splitting stabilized?

record.title: Surfaces in finite covers and the group determinant: Theorem 1
record.statement:
Let $Y$ be a hyperbolic $3$-manifold with one torus boundary component. Then either:

1. for all $n\in\mathbb{N}$, there is a regular cover $\widetilde{Y}\to Y$ and a slope $\alpha$ on $\partial Y$ such that $\alpha$ is a virtual homology slope for $\widetilde{Y}$ of rank at least $n$; or
2. every slope on $\partial Y$ is a virtual homology slope.

record.title: Local observables for factorizing S-matrices in the subfamily $\mathcal S_0$
record.statement: For every factorizing S-matrix $S\in\mathcal S_0$, do the corresponding wedge-local model theories contain observables localized in arbitrarily small double cones? The report answers this affirmatively: the modular nuclearity condition holds for every inclusion of wedge regions, so the corresponding local observable algebras are nontrivial and the inverse scattering problem has a solution.

record.title: Fourier’s 17-line intersection problem

u$ be its homogeneous dimension, $

u)$?

record.title: Upper bound for Hamiltonian cycles in tournaments
record.statement:

$$
\\Psi(T)=O(\\phi(n)),
\\qquad \\phi(n):=2^{-n}(n-1)!.
$$

record.title: Erdős–Sós conjecture for sufficiently large trees
record.statement:
There exists an integer $k_0$ such that, for every integer $k>k_0$, every $n$-vertex graph $G_n$ containing no $k$-vertex tree $T_k$ satisfies
\[
e(G_n)\le \frac{1}{2}(k-2)n.

record.title: Matching points to hyperplanes

record.title: Proper solutions for finite split embedding problems over large fields
record.statement: Let $F$ be a large field and let $X$ be a smooth projective connected $F$-curve, with function field $K$. record.title: Convergence of the random-graph k-colorability threshold
record.statement: For each fixed integer $k\ge 3$, let $d_k^*(n)$ be the Achlioptas–Friedgut threshold sequence such that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, a random graph with average degree $d_k^*(n)-\varepsilon$ is a.a.s. $k$-colorable, whereas a random graph with average degree $d_k^*(n)+\varepsilon$ is a.a.s. non-$k$-colorable. record.title: Conjectured list-labeling number of paths for equal distance constraints
record.statement: **Conjecture 2.** For every nonnegative integer $d$ and every path $P_n$ with $n\ge 3$, $$\chi^{d,d}_{\ell}(P_n)=\left\lfloor 3d\left(1-\frac{1}{n}\right)\right\rfloor+1.$$

record.title: Equality of list and ordinary $L(2,1)$-labelling numbers for trees
record.statement: For every tree $T$, it holds that $\chi^{\ell}_{2,1}(T)=\chi_{2,1}(T)$.

record.title: Dichotomy conjecture for digraph homomorphism
record.statement: For every fixed digraph $H$, the decision problem that, given an input digraph $G$, asks whether there is a homomorphism from $G$ to $H$ is either polynomial-time solvable or NP-complete.
